question: Compare bilateral hip policy sensitivity around reconstructed real observations

w2l_nov11.identity_limit: W2L user confirmed; matching archived model

wheel_nov11.identity_limit: Reference model; independent test-process hash absent; replay consistency reported separately

wheel_oct02_reference.window_basis: first 45 samples at or after bag 50.8s (same length, different trial)
wheel_oct02_reference.identity_limit: Reference model; independent test-process hash absent; replay consistency reported separately

method.derivative: Central finite differences, perturb only one hip input at one history slot; all other inputs held fixed. Physical input includes deployment observation scaling and target action scaling. Previous-target perturbation converted back to raw action using that policy action_scale. Both output hips differentiated.
method.histories: 10 frames, 20ms; main comparison first 45 mature-history samples: relative phase .2 <= t < 1.1. W2L term-major 590; Wheel time-major 390. Latest state reconstructed from preceding recorded 50Hz snapshot; previous actions reconstructed from preceding recorded target. This is approximate inference input, not a recorded network-input trace.
method.frequency: Frozen local Jacobian kernels evaluated as sum_l J_l exp(-i 2pi f l dt). Action branch has additional one-step delay. Report largest singular value of bilateral 2x2 branch response, median and p95 across 45 points; no motor/plant model. q+velocity sinusoid uses V multiplied by i2pi f. These are local policy gains, not measured closed-loop mechanical frequency responses.
method.verification: Repeat steps at half and twice size at every fifth operating point for all channels/lags. Source hashes verified against sim2real_test SHA256SUMS.
method.scope: CPU-only ONNX inference; no source/config edits, no hardware/simulation/training runs, no commit/push.
limits: Different operating trajectories and policies; observed differences do not isolate training design causally.
W2L reconstruction is approximate; its residual mismatch is retained.
Legacy Oct02 test-process model was not independently recorded; near-exact replay is consistency evidence only.
Local derivatives are not finite-perturbation recovery, actual hardware stability margins or motor gain estimates.
The previous-action branch and physical feedback are coupled in a real loop; compare branches without claiming standalone causal shares.
